notes.title: Bugfix #12
notes.notes:
A rather annoying bug that resulted in temporary or permanent displacement or even disappering of UI elements ingame has been fixed in this patch.
There have also been some quality of life updates and general game stability has been improved.

client-server interface improvements:

notes.title: Update 1.7 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Server 2.0[/h1]
We have created a new and improved server for the game.
This will allow us to easily expand it in the future, as well as add new features.

[h1]New Visuals![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/ead77af113bfa79d44b67d70c91bca8baf625c2b.png[/img]
We've overhauled the old trees and made some that are even better!

[h1]Deck Editor[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/11ffac61625823797e9982f0e6ca36e5a8bfbab7.png[/img]
The deck editor has been changed due to user requests.
It now supports multiple deck layouts and is much easier to use.

[h1]Updated in-game UI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/25031a20216b3a0be91c95f247c737f5f31bd0b0.png[/img]
The old blueprint system has been removed from the game and has been substituted by a new system.
This new system allows you to view unit information mid-game and easily manage your army!

notes.title: Golden Crystal Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/eeedc7b1c3440239c4586a07685dd337e4506eff.png[/img]

We saw that matches were taking too long.
So we added a brand new feature which gets activated when a match takes more then 30 turns.

A [b]golden crystal[/b] will appear ontop of the center crystal!
The first player to capture this golden crystal will win the match.

This way people are more preasured to win before the [b]30 turn counter[/b] ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/73c1ca40828267740b53ae01d403db2145fe1764.png[/img]

We hope this will makes the game more fun.
And more enjoyable as a quick game you can play inside your breaks.
